run_selfplay_evaluation: run a self-play AI vs AI evaluation using SingleProcessRun with two evaluators
create_evaluator: create an Evaluator instance with a name and verbose flag for episode tracking
load_environment: load the environment with load_env specifying num_models, evaluators, runner, and actor_only overrides
initialize_selfplay: initialize self-play game configuration using env game initialize_selfplay to get game config params
setup_model_interface: setup a ModelInterface adding an actor model and register it as a callback with the game config
